summary: Create a ClientRequest without automatically ending it.

target.notes: Returns ClientRequest immediately; request is Writable/EventEmitter; callback is response listener; body/headers remain mutable until committed.

semantics.notes: Returns ClientRequest immediately; request is Writable/EventEmitter; callback is response listener; body/headers remain mutable until committed.

caveats: Preserve Node stream/EventEmitter, host ordering, header state, and network/TLS behavior rather than substituting unrelated .NET HTTP defaults.
